fact: On 2 September 2026 Collins Magalasi was formally charged in the Lilongwe Chief Resident Magistrate's Court under Section 83(1) as read with Section 89 of the Electronic Transactions and Cyber Security Act 2016 for allegedly aiding the hacking of the President's and officials' phones.
title: Magalasi charged with hacking Malawi President's phone and senior officials' numbers
